{{Top|ga|audio=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=42j-uxqwHHQ}} {{CelestialBody |image=[[File:Killun-71.png]] |name=Killun 71 |region=*[[Outer Rim Territories]]{{GalaxyMapAppendix}} — Based on corresponding data for the [[Killun Station system]] *[[The Slice]]''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'' places [[Killun Station]] in the area of [[Realspace|space]] ''[[Star Wars: The Galactic Explorer's Guide]]'' identifies as [[the Slice]]. As "[[Double Agent Droid]]" establishes that Killun Station is located on Killun 71, the [[moon]] must also be part of the Slice. |sector=[[Pakuuni sector]] |system=[[Killun Station system]] |coordinates=[[Standard Galactic Grid|T-6]][[Star Wars Galaxy Map (poster)|''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map poster]] — Based on corresponding data for [[Killun Station]] |xyz= |distance= |suns= |orbited= |position= |moons= |routes=[[Overic Griplink]]{{GalaxyMapHyperlanes|route=Overic Griplink|canon=''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''|leg=''[[The Essential Atlas]]''}} |lengthday= |lengthyear= |class=Terrestrial{{Rebels|Double Agent Droid}} |diameter= |atmosphere=[[Color|Green]] [[Water|mist]]{{Databank|killun-71|Killun 71}} |climate= |gravity= |terrain=Jagged rock spires |water= |interest=[[Killun Station]] |flora= |fauna= |otherlife= |species= |otherspecies=[[Human]]s |socialgroup= |language= |government= |population= |demonym= |cities= |imports= |exports= |affiliation=[[Galactic Empire]] }} {{Quote|Controller, an unauthorized droid has just entered the ISB base on Killun 71.|[[3-9]], reporting to Controller LT-319|audio=3-9-Controller.flac|}} '''Killun 71''' was a [[moon]] located in the [[Killun Station system]] within the [[Pakuuni sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]] that was occupied by the [[Galactic Empire]] in the [[Standard year|years]] leading up to the [[Galactic Civil War]]. Its jagged, rocky surface made it difficult to colonize, though the Empire operated an outpost known as [[Killun Station]] on one of the rocky protrusions. In an attempt to acquire codes relevant to [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] operations on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]], the rebel cell known as [[Phoenix Cell|Phoenix Squadron]] [[Mission to recover Imperial codes|infiltrated]] the outpost, stealing sensitive information from the Empire. ==Description== Killun 71 was a [[moon]] located within [[the Slice]] and [[Outer Rim Territories]]—in the [[Pakuuni sector]]'s [[Killun Station system]]—situated in grid square T-6 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]] along the [[Overic Griplink]] [[hyperspace route]], which connected to the [[planet]]{{TCW|Water War}} [[Mon Cala]] and astronomical object [[Florn]]. Located near a larger, [[Color|white]] celestial body, the moon had a green appearance from [[Realspace|space]]; this was due to an omnipresent layer of [[Water|mist]] in its [[atmosphere]]. Its terrain was composed of large, rocky protrusions and jagged landmasses that made colonization difficult. ==History== {{Quote|I will alert the station at once.''"
"''No, we'll inform the ISB after I have what I need from that spy.|3-9 and Controller LT-319 discover Chopper infiltrating Killun Station|audio=3-9-Alert.flac|}} [[File:KillunStation.png|thumb|left|250px|The Imperial base Killun Station sat on one of the moon's jagged landmasses prior to the Galactic Civil War.]] Despite the moon's large, jagged rocks, the [[Galactic Empire]] maintained an outpost on Killun 71 known as [[Killun Station]]. Established and operated by the [[Imperial Security Bureau]], Killun Station contained sensitive data and [[orbit]]al clearance codes for the [[planet]] [[Lothal]], making the base a prime target for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] cell known as [[Phoenix Cell|Phoenix Squadron]], which was planning an upcoming attack on Lothal. In [[2 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[Double Agent Droid]]" to [[2 BBY]]. Phoenix Squadron agents [[Wedge Antilles]] and the [[droid]]s [[C1-10P]] and [[AP-5]] [[Mission to recover Imperial codes|infiltrated Killun Station]] to recover the Lothal codes. Although Chopper was compromised by [[Imperial Information Office]] [[Controller]] [[Boon|LT-319]],{{Databank|controller-lt-319|Controller LT-319}} the two droids were ultimately successful in their mission. ==Locations== {{Quote|Halt. Proceed through the scanner one at a time.|An Imperial stormtrooper enforces Killun Station's tight security measures|audio=KillunStormtrooper-Halt.flac|}} One of Killun 71's jagged landmasses was home to Killun Station, an outpost operated by [[human]]s and [[droid]]s of the Imperial Security Bureau. Due to the sensitive nature of the data stored in the base, security was especially tight. [[Stormtrooper]]s were stationed at every entrance, and the base was equipped with [[walkthrough identification scanner]]s.{{Databank|killun-station|Killun Station}} ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Killun_71_concept_art.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Concept art of Killun 71 for "Double Agent Droid"]] Killun 71 made its first appearance in "[[Double Agent Droid]]," the nineteenth episode in the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|third season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''. The episode aired on [[March 11]], [[2017]].{{TVcom|url=shows/star-wars-rebels/double-agent-droid-3447914|text=Star Wars Rebels - Season 3, Episode 18: Double Agent Droid}} "Killun 71" is likely a reference to ''Star Wars Rebels'' art director [[Kilian Plunkett]], who was born in [[1971]].{{WebCite|url=https://www.mylife.com/kilian-plunkett/kilianplunkett|text=Kilian Plunkett (F), 47 - Berkeley, CA|work=[[Wikipedia:MyLife|MyLife]]|archivedate=20180829015548}} According to series creator [[Dave Filoni]], the environment design used for the landscape of Killun 71 was adapted from a concept originally made for an unproduced episode of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', in which the [[Cloning|clones]] attempted to capture{{HomeVideoCite|set=Star Wars Rebels: Complete Season Three|episode=Double Agent Droid}} [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]]{{Databank|count-dooku|Count Dooku}} [[Dooku]] on their own. ==Appearances== *{{Rebels|Double Agent Droid}} {{1st}} ==Sources== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Killun 71}} *{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/double-agent-droid-episode-guide|text="Double Agent Droid" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}} *''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' *{{EncyclopediaCite|BB-8 and Other Astromech Droids}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Starships of the Empire and the Rebellion}} {{Po}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Protocol and Service Droids}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Databank|controller-lt-319|Controller LT-319}} *{{Databank|killun-71|Killun 71}} *{{Databank|killun-station|Killun Station}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=キラン71 }} [[Category:Galactic Empire moons]] [[Category:Locations along the Overic Griplink]] [[Category:Moons in the Outer Rim Territories]] [[Category:Moons in the Slice]] [[Category:Pakuuni sector locations]] [[Category:Rocky moons]]
